task: Add DOCX/PDF export options in codemie-ui to hide tool outputs by default (with a separate 'include tool outputs' variant), plus loading and duplicate-click UI state for the export action.

key_reasoning.reason: 3-4 components across 2-3 layers with shared-utility involvement: ChatHeaderDownloadConversationButton.tsx (menu items + UI state), chats.ts store methods (exportChat, possibly exportConversationAIMessage), and the shared api.ts downloadFileStream helper reused by five unrelated download flows (dataSources, files, workflowExecutions, agentWorkspace).

Technical-analysis flags an unresolved architectural question: the core AC (default tool-output filtering, formatting preservation) is implemented server-side in the separate codemie backend, not in codemie-ui, so it is undecided whether this ticket needs a coordinated backend change this repo cannot deliver alone. Additional open design decisions: menu-item extension vs. popup pattern (WorkflowExecutionExportPopup precedent), and whether exportConversationAIMessage is in scope for consistency.

No exact precedent for a tool-output export toggle exists (the similarly-named hideToolOutputs chat-display toggle is a structurally separate, unrelated feature, risking confusion during implementation); UI patterns needed (loading state, duplicate-click guard, spinner) do have direct precedent. Performance/stability is the ticket's explicit primary concern (failed exports for large payloads), which is the Step 5 red flag for Technical Risk.

Estimated 5-7 modified files (ChatHeaderDownloadConversationButton.tsx, chats.ts, possibly ChatAiMessageActions.tsx, types/chats.ts, two existing test files) plus new/extended test coverage for menu-item clicks, loading state, and duplicate-click prevention, spanning 3+ directories (ChatHeader, ChatHeader/__tests__, store, store/__tests__, possibly ChatHistory/ChatAiMessage).
